This article compares the reasons for patient exclusion across Denmark and its five regions (Hovedstaden, Sjælland, Syddanmark, Midtjylland, and Nordjylland) in relation to [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] [^src1]. The data highlights the specific criteria used to exclude patients from the indicator's dataset, revealing significant disparities in both the volume and the nature of exclusions nationally and regionally.

Nationally, the overwhelming leader in exclusion reasons is "Patienten er ikke opereret" (The patient was not operated on), accounting for 6,646 excluded patients across Denmark [^src1]. This figure drastically outnumbers all other categories, acting as a major outlier in the dataset. In contrast, the lowest exclusion reason nationally is "Eksklusion: Ugyldigt CPR-nummer." (Exclusion: Invalid CPR number), which accounts for only 79 patients [^src1]. Other notable national exclusion figures include 544 patients excluded because the procedure was not their first operation during the hospital stay, and 177 patients excluded because they were under 18 years of age [^src1].

When examining the regional breakdown, the Capital Region (Hovedstaden) consistently records the highest number of exclusions across every single category, leading with 1,609 non-operated patients, 188 non-first operations, 67 underage patients, and 31 invalid CPR numbers [^src1]. Conversely, the North Denmark Region (Nordjylland) consistently records the lowest figures across all categories, with 992 non-operated patients, 29 non-first operations, 12 underage patients, and 8 invalid CPR numbers [^src1]. Because this comparison is drawn from a single dated section, no longitudinal trends can be established regarding whether these exclusion volumes are increasing or decreasing over time.

| Årsag | Danmark | Hovedstaden | Sjælland | Syddanmark | Midtjylland | Nordjylland |

| Eksklusion: Ugyldigt CPR-nummer. | 79 | 31 | 10 | 19 | 11 | 8 |
| Patienten er under 18 år. | 177 | 67 | 9 | 53 | 36 | 12 |
| Patienten er ikke opereret. | 6.646 | 1.609 | 1.024 | 1.442 | 1.579 | 992 |
| Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet. | 544 | 188 | 77 | 143 | 107 | 29 |

Entities: indikator-8

Summary: Tabellen præsenterer antallet af ekskluderede patienter for Indikator 8 fordelt på fire årsager og seks regioner, hvor 'Patienten er ikke opereret' udgør langt den største gruppe med 6.646 patienter i hele Danmark.
